stock.description: King's Stone Holdings Group Ltd. operates as an investment holding company, with its core business being the supply of various formwork solutions. The organization's activities are divided across two primary segments: Construction Services and Dealing and Broking. Its formwork products encompass both traditional methods utilizing timber and plywood, and modern system formwork crafted from aluminium and steel. The company was established on July 24, 2018, and maintains its corporate headquarters in Hong Kong.
